content.thinking: I noticed some GL accruals were posted by other users (RLOPEZ, MPATEL) with posting dates that look suspicious. I'll now dig into the AP side, comparing invoice journals against invoices, and examine the duplicate journals more closely.

input.sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", p."STAT_CD" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where i."INV_ID" in (348,802,510,801,509,803) or i."INV_DT"<>h."POST_DT" or trim(h."SRC_REF")<>trim(i."INV_NO") order by 1

select h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF" not like 'PAY-%' and not exists (select 1 from "APINVH" i where i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")

select i."INV_ID", i."JRNL_NO", i."INV_AMT", string_agg(trim(l."ACCT_CD")||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ', ') from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3 having count(*) filter (where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000')<>1 or sum(l."DR_AMT")<>abs(i."INV_AMT") order by 1
